title: Query probability from structural probabilities
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty alphabet with probability law $\pi$, and let $\iota$ be a finite nonempty index set. Suppose the real-valued functions on $\Omega$ have a basis indexed by $\iota$ that includes the constant-one function and is orthonormal for the inner product weighted by $\pi$. Let $T$ be a randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space, and let $i$ be an input coordinate. The probability that $T$ queries $i$ under independent inputs of law $\pi$ equals the seed-law average of the structural query probabilities of its deterministic trees.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nonempty index set $\iota$ with decidable equality
